the left sum runs over ALL complex zeros rho with no height, cutoff or ordinate anywhere in the statement; the height is the corpus instrument`s truncation of that sum -- `AT.GAM`, the first ten thousand banked ordinates -- and not a datum of the formula
the compact support of f is a condition the source states; its width is a datum of that support
